card.desc:
# **When equipped gives you:**

**+5 Ability**

**+3 Strength**

**+5 Health**

**Fate’s Chosen (**[https://trello.com/c/5ekINxOZ/86-rolling-stones](https://trello.com/c/5ekINxOZ/86-rolling-stones "smartCard-inline")  **is more likely to choose you as its target, and is faster while following you.)**

**Crimson’s Mark (You take more damage from** [https://trello.com/c/PuCb64p0/344-king-crimson-full](https://trello.com/c/PuCb64p0/344-king-crimson-full "smartCard-inline")  **after the user uses Timeskip, Time Erase or Epitaph for 10 seconds.**

**One-time Epitaph (After getting hit 10 times, you activate a one-time Epitaph effect, dodging the next attack.)**

## **Obtained from:** [https://trello.com/c/5GhlPI4P/710-the-statue-of-sorrow](https://trello.com/c/5GhlPI4P/710-the-statue-of-sorrow "smartCard-inline")  (If caught by Rolling Stones)
card.name: Slave Of Fate
